title: Benchmark/training task (ARCHITECTURE §7.2). gold_spec is null only for ambiguous/unsupported tasks.

style.description: Phrasing style the request was rendered in (taskgen v1); held-out styles populate test-phrasing.

content_key.description: sha256 of (families, inputs, gold_spec): paraphrases/styles of one task share it, and splits are assigned by it.

families.description: At least one family, except unsupported tasks, which belong to none (empty list; spike-v0 still lists a nominal family there, spike-v1 requires []).

nearest_supported.description: Unsupported tasks only: the closest supported family the agent may name in its `unsupported` action, or null when nothing is close. Optional elsewhere.
